about: Golden data for the mutation game / numbers game / Satake engine. Generated by reference/verify.py.

conventions.node_labels: Bourbaki, 1-based in this file; on affine boards the added node is labelled 0 and listed first
conventions.adjacency: A[i][j] = number of directed edges i -> j = -C[j][i]
conventions.mutation: p_i <- p_i - sum_j C[i][j] p_j (only entry i changes)
conventions.firing: a_j <- a_j - C[j][i] a_i for all j (so a_i <- -a_i)
conventions.legal_firing_rule: fire a node whose label is positive; the game stops when no label is positive
conventions.longest_word_rule: always fire the lowest-numbered positive node, starting from all ones
conventions.rank_two_naming: the root system B2 = C2 is always written B2 in computed fields; the affine board of B2 is named C2~
conventions.floats: the only floating-point values are the ring radii under types[T].coxeter_plane, rounded to 6 decimals
